component.name: Fprint-Manager
component.summary: Manage fingerprint readers and enrolled prints cleanly
Gestiona lectores biométricos y huellas registradas fácilmente

description.p: Fprint-Manager is a clean, hardware-agnostic Linux desktop utility designed for elementary OS and GTK environments to enroll, test, rename, and manage fingerprint readers backed by fprintd and libfprint over D-Bus.

Fprint-Manager es una utilidad de escritorio Linux minimalista pensada para elementary OS y entornos GTK que permite registrar, verificar, renombrar y administrar lectores de huellas compatibles con fprintd y libfprint mediante D-Bus.

ul.li: Works with any libfprint-supported optical, capacitive, or match-on-chip reader
Interactive multi-stage enrollment progress ring and live verification feedback
Custom local aliases, verification history log, and PAM/Polkit diagnostics

screenshot.caption: Fprint-Manager main window with enrolled prints and live sensor scanner
Ventana principal de Fprint-Manager con huellas registradas y escáner en vivo

description.p: Initial release with universal D-Bus fprintd support, interactive enrollment animations, custom aliases, verification audit log, and AppCenter Flatpak packaging.
Lanzamiento inicial con soporte universal D-Bus para fprintd, animaciones de registro interactivas, apodos personalizados, historial y empaquetado Flatpak para AppCenter.
